Fine adjustment relative to the calibrated timing: negative values advance the upper earpiece, positive values delay it. Available with both speakers in stereo. Pause and resume playback to apply. Saved after restarting.

These experimental controls apply to media playback. Preferences are kept after restarting. A single selected speaker plays a mix of both channels; with both speakers selected, Stereo channels chooses stereo or dual mono. The speakers differ in volume and tone.
